chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from a man, from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the knots of the shroud of the deceased. He said: “When you place him into the grave, then untie them.”

key_terms.الْقَبْرَ: the grave into which the deceased is buried
key_terms.عُقَدِ: the knots or ties fastened on the shroud
key_terms.كَفَنِ: the burial shroud in which the deceased is wrapped

ai.seo_question: When should the knots of a deceased person’s shroud be untied according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the burial of the deceased. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that the knots of the deceased’s shroud should be untied after the body has been placed in the grave.
